jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Location: Hybrid (San Francisco or Boston preferred) or Remote for the Right Individual

About AllSpice

At AllSpice, we're building a platform for hardware engineering teams to collaborate, automate, and supercharge their workflows. By applying proven software development principles and AI technology to the hardware lifecycle, we’re redefining how a $6.5B+ industry designs, builds, and collaborates - powering innovation across electronics teams worldwide.

Read more about us in TechCrunch here, and our latest Series A announcement here!

We’re entering a high growth phase and are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to help scale revenue, close complex deals, and build long term relationships with engineering led organizations. This role combines strategic enterprise selling with hands-on execution and close collaboration with product and leadership.

The ideal candidate is a hunter who is comfortable navigating ambiguity, thrives in deeply technical conversations, and has experience selling emerging or category-defining technology to sophisticated buyers.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and drive enterprise revenue growth across a defined set of target accounts

  • Manage the full sales cycle end to end: outbound prospecting, discovery, demo, negotiation, and close

  • Run structured, value-driven discovery calls and demos that map AllSpice’s capabilities to technical and business needs

  • Sell multi-stakeholder, six to eight figure deals to engineering, product, and executive buyers

  • Build and manage pipeline using HubSpot, leveraging personalized outbound and account based strategies

  • Rigorously qualify and forecast deals using MEDDPIC

  • Collaborate with marketing, product, and customer experience teams to refine messaging, pricing, and objection handling

  • Capture and synthesize customer and market feedback to influence roadmap and positioning

  • Contribute to and help evolve sales playbooks, processes, and onboarding materials

  • Represent AllSpice at industry events, conferences, and tradeshows

  • Compete effectively against incumbent and emerging solutions by clearly quantifying business value and ROI

What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in a quota carrying SaaS sales role, ideally selling technical platforms, developer tools, or hardware-adjacent products

  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding quota in complex, multi-threaded sales cycles

  • Demonstrated success closing six to eight figure enterprise deals

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable engaging engineers, technical leaders, and executives

  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot and outbound tools (e.g., Buzz or similar), plus virtual demo platforms (Zoom, Loom)

  • Deep familiarity with MEDDPIC as a qualification and forecasting methodology

  • Ability to run disciplined deal reviews and confidently forecast pipeline health

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, proactive, resourceful, and energized by building in a fast-moving environment

  • High EQ, strong collaboration skills, and a bias toward action

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling to technical buyers such as hardware engineers, product development teams, or manufacturing organizations

  • Background in electrical or mechanical engineering, or adjacent technical fields

  • Prior experience at an early stage startup or category defining company

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

  • Generous PTO

  • Flexible work arrangements (hybrid or remote)

  • Home + in-office stipends

  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact at a fast-growing company alongside a smart, supportive team

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, AI Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help define the future of hardware development! At AllSpice, we're building the automation engine that powers the next generation of circuit design, enabling breakthroughs in smart vehicles, robotics, rockets, IoT, medical devices, and more.

We're creating the agile development environment for hardware engineers with a Git-friendly translation layer and automated CI/CD framework for native circuit designs. Think GitHub/GitLab + Copilot for electronics.

Our mission is to bring the same modern workflows that revolutionized software: version control, automation, and collaboration to the hardware world.

Learn more about our journey in TechCrunch and our recent Series A announcement.

If you're passionate about building tools that empower teams and delight customers, and you want to shape the foundation of modern hardware DevOps, we'd love to meet you!

Read more at https://allspice.io

What will you do?

This is a senior, high-impact software engineering role at the intersection of AI platform development, data engineering, and full-stack product development. You will own the tooling, evaluation systems, and data platforms that make AllSpice's Generative AI team more effective. Your primary users will be internal engineers and product managers, with opportunities to build customer-facing experiences where they support our AI products.

We’re looking for someone who can identify the right problems, make thoughtful technical decisions, and take solutions from discovery through implementation, adoption, and ongoing improvement. As you build domain knowledge and establish the AI platform foundation, we’d also like you to grow into contributing directly to AllSpice’s core product alongside the product engineering team. This is an aspirational growth opportunity, not a prerequisite or the role’s initial primary focus.

You will:

  • Partner with engineers and product managers to discover workflow bottlenecks, prioritize the highest-impact problems, and own solutions end-to-end—from requirements and architecture to rollout and iteration.

  • Own the evaluation and observability layer for our AI products, including automated and human review workflows, regression detection, and comparisons across models, prompts, and pipelines. Make quality, cost, latency, usage, and customer outcomes visible and actionable.

  • Build usable internal applications and self-service tools that help engineers and product managers inspect AI results, investigate failures, and provide feedback. Where useful, extend these capabilities into customer-facing experiences.

  • Build and maintain scripts, reliable data pipelines, and integrations that connect internal systems, third-party services, LLMs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools, with attention to data quality, schema evolution, and customer data privacy.

  • Write clear documentation and communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership and customers.

  • Champion code quality, testing, and reliability across the tooling stack through reviews, mentorship, and thoughtful design.

Example Projects

  • Build an internal evaluation workspace for DRCY, our AI design review product, that captures run configurations, inputs, outputs, and telemetry; compares model and prompt changes; and tracks quality, false positives, cost, and latency over time.

  • Develop review workflows that let engineers and product managers inspect AI-generated findings, apply scoring rubrics, override automated scores, and investigate regressions—with opportunities to surface relevant insights and feedback workflows to customers.

  • Create and maintain data pipelines that aggregate evaluation results, customer feedback, and telemetry into a unified analytics layer.

  • Build scripting tools and automations to streamline the Gen AI team's development and testing workflows (e.g., batch evaluation runs, report generation).

  • Design and implement RAG-based information repositories and tooling to capture component data and domain knowledge for use by our suite of AI products.

  • Integrate with CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions) to surface AI insights directly in engineering workflows.

  • Partner with infrastructure to measure cache effectiveness, usage, and cost, and use those insights to improve the reliability and efficiency of AI workflows.

  • As an aspirational next step, contribute directly to core AllSpice product features—for example, integrating AI review findings and feedback into existing engineering workflows—in partnership with the product engineering team.

Our stack

  • Languages: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, SQL

  • Analytics & Data: SQL databases (Postgres), Jupyter Notebooks, business intelligence/analytics tools

  • AI/LLM: Langchain, Pydantic AI, Langfuse

  • Web: Vue/TypeScript front-end, common web architectures and APIs

  • Infrastructure: GitHub Actions for CI/CD, Docker Swarm & Terraform, AWS

  • Our Hub application is a soft fork of Gitea

    • Go [server-side]

    • Vue/TypeScript Front-end

Expectations

Our ideal candidate should have the following:

  • 4+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on tooling, data platforms, or full-stack web development, with demonstrated senior-level ownership of systems or products that other people depend on.

  • Strong SQL skills and experience designing data pipelines and storage schemas, handling data quality and schema evolution, and using data/analytics tools (e.g., Jupyter, Metabase, Looker, or similar BI platforms).

  • Proficiency in Python scripting and automation for data pipelines, integrations, and internal tools.

  • Experience building web applications or customer-facing tools using modern frameworks (e.g., Vue, React, TypeScript).

  • Practical experience shipping or maintaining LLM-enabled systems and building infrastructure around them, such as evaluation pipelines, observability, or integrations. You understand non-determinism, quality and reliability challenges, and tradeoffs across cost, latency, and model performance.

  • Excellent communication skills — you can translate technical findings into clear insights for engineers, product managers, and customers alike.

  • A customer-first mindset: you think about the end-user experience and proactively seek feedback to improve the tools you build.

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in a technology-related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Project management skills with the ability to lead and collaborate with varied stakeholders to move projects forward.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and autonomy: you independently identify problems, propose solutions, make pragmatic build-vs.-buy and architectural decisions, and bring stakeholders along in a fast-moving environment.

  • (Preferred) Availability to work out of our flex offices in San Francisco or Boston on a hybrid basis (2–3 times/week), but we are flexible for the right candidate.

Relevant Skills

You don't necessarily have to be proficient in all of these, but the more you know, the better:

  • Python, TypeScript, SQL

  • Business analytics and data visualization tools

  • Langchain, Pydantic AI, and LLM evaluation frameworks

  • GitHub Actions development and CI/CD

  • Common web architectures, APIs, and front-end frameworks (Vue, React)

  • Monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Langfuse, DataDog, Grafana)

  • Project management and stakeholder communication

Benefits

  • Supportive and smart colleagues, flexible work, opportunity to make a big impact, competitive salary & equity, health, dental, vision, generous PTO, home office stipend.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Location: Hybrid (San Francisco or Boston preferred) or Remote for the Right Individual

About AllSpice

At AllSpice, we're building a platform for hardware engineering teams to collaborate, automate, and supercharge their workflows. By applying proven software development principles and AI technology to the hardware lifecycle, we're redefining how a $6.5B+ industry designs, builds, and collaborates - powering innovation across electronics teams worldwide.

Read more about us in TechCrunch here, and our latest Series A announcement here!

We're entering a high-growth phase and are looking for a Business Development Representative (BDR) to be a key driver of our growth engine. You'll work hand-in-hand with our Enterprise Account Executives, reporting directly to the Head of Enterprise Sales, identifying engineering teams that are an ideal fit for AllSpice and getting meaningful exposure to the full sales cycle.

What You'll Do

Prospecting and Pipeline Generation

  • Leverage the latest AI tools to supercharge outbound prospecting and identify engineering teams that are a strong fit for AllSpice

  • Qualify new business opportunities from marketing leads, targeted company research, and networking within the engineering community

  • Maintain accurate records of interactions, leads, and progress in our CRM system

  • Close opportunistic deals within our growth segment (companies with 0 to 500 employees)

Outreach and Engagement

  • Engage potential customers through calls, emails, and social media to introduce AllSpice's value proposition

  • Schedule high-quality meetings for Account Executives and ensure smooth lead handoffs

  • Work closely with marketing and sales to develop targeted outbound campaigns

Market and Customer Intelligence

  • Stay current on industry trends, competitors, and target markets to identify new opportunities and sharpen your outreach

  • Navigate complex organizational structures to find the right engineering stakeholders and decision makers

  • Participate in ongoing training to develop your sales skills and deepen your product knowledge

What We're Looking For

  • At least one year of experience in a sales development or similar role

  • Genuine enthusiasm for how things work, whether in hardware, engineering, product design, or adjacent technical fields

  • A natural appetite for AI tools and using software to work smarter and faster

  • Curiosity and persistence in working through unstructured problems and complex org charts to find the right people

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a knack for building relationships quickly

  • Self-starter mentality with a proactive approach to identifying and pursuing new opportunities

  • Comfortable working in a collaborative, fast-paced startup environment

Bonus Points

  • Experience in a startup or early-stage tech environment

  • Exposure to the hardware industry or experience working alongside hardware engineering teams

  • Familiarity with MEDDIC or MEDDPICC qualification methodology

Why AllSpice

  • Be part of a team transforming the hardware industry with an AI-first approach

  • Get first-hand exposure to full-cycle enterprise deals and work closely with senior Account Executives on strategic accounts

  • Your contributions will have a direct and visible impact on company growth

  • A culture built on curiosity, creativity, and a hands-on approach to problem-solving

Benefits

Competitive salary and equity

Health, dental, and vision insurance

Generous PTO

Flexible work arrangements (hybrid or remote)

Home + in-office stipends

Opportunity to make a meaningful impact at a fast-growing company alongside a smart, supportive team

jobs.title: Principal / Staff Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help define the future of hardware development by building a collaboration platform for circuit designs, enabling the next generation of smart vehicles, IoT devices, rockets, medical devices, robotics, and much more.

At AllSpice, we're building the agile development framework for hardware designers, including a Git-friendly translation layer and automated CI/CD framework for native circuit designs — think GitHub/GitLab + Copilot for electronics.

Read more about our latest Series A announcement here!

As a Sr./Principal Infrastructure Engineer, you will improve our cloud infrastructure architecture and security operations as we scale up our products and services.

If you are passionate about optimizing infrastructure at scale and have experience in security engineering, this role is for you.

What you'll do

This is a high-impact role that comes with lots of autonomy and requires a self-driven, collaborative person. You will own new server deployments and automation, and should be able to:

  • Work closely with a customer success manager to manage enterprise deployments and SSO integrations

  • Work closely with application developers to deploy infrastructure solutions to product problems

  • Document our security processes and identify opportunities for improvement

  • Manage the process for security compliance certification (ISO 27001 & SOC 2) and pentesting

  • Coordinate improvements to architecture and hosting services

  • Automate new software deployments, data backups, and data recovery

  • Monitor and improve the performance and availability of our cloud infrastructure

  • Take part in an on-call rotation and respond to incidents, driving blameless postmortems that prevent recurrence

Example projects

  • Scale out our infrastructure for zero-downtime software deployments

  • Identify opportunities to decrease cloud cost and increase performance

  • Conduct stress-testing for backups and establish disaster recovery processes

  • Manage process for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 audit

  • Work with the development team to support CI/CD workflows

  • detect security flaws, perform penetration testing, and conduct red team exercises

Our stack

  • Terraform & Docker Swarm for deployment, migrating to Kubernetes (K8s)

  • AWS for production

  • Grafana, Loki, and Prometheus for observability

  • GitHub Actions for CI/CD

  • Playwright for e2e testing

  • Gitea application fork

    • Go [server-side]

  • Rust back-end parsing layer for ECAD files

  • PostgreSQL

  • Crysknife

Expectations

Our ideal candidate has:

  • [Principal] 8+ years of cloud infrastructure and/or security engineering experience

  • [Staff] 6+ years of cloud infrastructure and/or security engineering experience

  • Deep hands-on expertise with AWS services (IAM, GuardDuty, AWS WAF, etc.) and Linux administration

  • Experience managing security compliance programs (SOC 2, ISO 27001) and penetration testing

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to drive cross-functional initiatives

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a high degree of autonomy

  • Can think in terms of the big picture and deliver on the details

  • Fluency with AI tools — you use them day-to-day to debug, document, and reduce operational toil, and expect this to be a normal part of how the team operates

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in a technology-related field

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen or Lawful Permanent Resident (Green Card holder)

  • (preference, not required) Availability to work out of our flex offices in San Francisco or Boston 1–2 days per week

Relevant skills

You don't need to check every box, but the more of these you bring, the better:

  • AWS services, particularly security-focused services, such as IAM, GuardDuty, AWS WAF, etc.

  • Terraform, Ansible and infrastructure-as-code experience

  • SOC 2 and ISO 27001 process familiarity

  • Logging aggregation and metrics observability (e.g. Loki, Datadog)

  • Docker and Kubernetes and/or Helm experience

  • Distributed systems design and operation, including secure multi-tenant SaaS and self-hosted deployments

  • SBOM generation and audit

  • Bash and Python scripting; Go or Rust programming experience (our application back-end and parsing layer)

  • nginx and alternate reverse-proxy services

  • Documentation and project management

  • SSO, OIDC, and LDAP

  • Data lakes and high-availability services

  • Experience with the Crysknife would be a bonus

Benefits

  • Opportunity to make a large impact

  • Supportive and smart colleagues

  • Flexible work

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Health, dental, and vision benefits

  • Generous PTO

  • Home office stipend

  • Relocation package

If you are passionate about optimizing infrastructure at scale and have experience in security engineering, this role is for you.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

This is a high-impact role that comes with lots of autonomy and requires a self-driven, collaborative person. You will own new server deployments and automation, and should be able to:

 - Work closely with a customer success manager to manage enterprise deployments and SSO integrations

 - Work closely with application developers to deploy infrastructure solutions to product problems

 - Document our security processes and identify opportunities for improvement

 - Manage the process for security compliance certification (ISO 27001 & SOC 2) and pentesting

 - Coordinate improvements to architecture and hosting services

 - Automate new software deployments, data backups, and data recovery

 - Monitor and improve the performance and availability of our cloud infrastructure

 - Take part in an on-call rotation and respond to incidents, driving blameless postmortems that prevent recurrence


EXAMPLE PROJECTS

 - Scale out our infrastructure for zero-downtime software deployments

 - Identify opportunities to decrease cloud cost and increase performance

 - Conduct stress-testing for backups and establish disaster recovery processes

 - Manage process for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 audit

 - Work with the development team to support CI/CD workflows

 - detect security flaws, perform penetration testing, and conduct red team exercises


OUR STACK

 - Terraform & Docker Swarm for deployment, migrating to Kubernetes (K8s)

 - AWS for production

 - Grafana, Loki, and Prometheus for observability

 - GitHub Actions for CI/CD

 - Playwright for e2e testing

 - Gitea https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea application fork
   
   - Go [server-side]

 - Rust back-end parsing layer for ECAD files

 - PostgreSQL

 - Crysknife


EXPECTATIONS

Our ideal candidate has:

 - [Principal] 8+ years of cloud infrastructure and/or security engineering experience

 - [Staff] 6+ years of cloud infrastructure and/or security engineering experience

 - Deep hands-on expertise with AWS services (IAM, GuardDuty, AWS WAF, etc.) and Linux administration

 - Experience managing security compliance programs (SOC 2, ISO 27001) and penetration testing

 - Strong project management skills with the ability to drive cross-functional initiatives

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a high degree of autonomy

 - Can think in terms of the big picture and deliver on the details

 - Fluency with AI tools — you use them day-to-day to debug, document, and reduce operational toil, and expect this to be a normal part of how the team operates

 - Bachelor's degree or higher in a technology-related field

 - Must be a U.S. Citizen or Lawful Permanent Resident (Green Card holder)

 - (preference, not required) Availability to work out of our flex offices in San Francisco or Boston 1–2 days per week


RELEVANT SKILLS

You don't need to check every box, but the more of these you bring, the better:

 - AWS services, particularly security-focused services, such as IAM, GuardDuty, AWS WAF, etc.

 - Terraform, Ansible and infrastructure-as-code experience

 - SOC 2 and ISO 27001 process familiarity

 - Logging aggregation and metrics observability (e.g. Loki, Datadog)

 - Docker and Kubernetes and/or Helm experience

 - Distributed systems design and operation, including secure multi-tenant SaaS and self-hosted deployments

 - SBOM generation and audit

 - Bash and Python scripting; Go or Rust programming experience (our application back-end and parsing layer)

 - nginx and alternate reverse-proxy services

 - Documentation and project management

 - SSO, OIDC, and LDAP

 - Data lakes and high-availability services

 - Experience with the Crysknife would be a bonus

 - Opportunity to make a large impact

 - Supportive and smart colleagues

 - Flexible work

 - Health, dental, and vision benefits

 - Generous PTO

 - Home office stipend

jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About AllSpice

AllSpice is building the workflow infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams.

Hardware teams are developing the next generation of autonomous vehicles, robots, rockets, medical devices, industrial systems, AI infrastructure, and advanced connected products. But the way they operate is still dominated by PDFs, shared drives, email threads, manual reviews, disconnected tools, and institutional knowledge trapped in individual engineers’ heads.

AllSpice helps electrical and hardware engineering teams collaborate on circuit designs, review changes, automate checks, manage design history, and build a reliable system of record for complex hardware development.

We’re at a critical inflection point with strong enterprise demand, a growing GTM engine, deep technical differentiation, and a product surface that spans collaboration, automation, AI, enterprise workflows, and hardware development infrastructure. We’re looking for a VP of Product to help turn that opportunity into a focused, category-defining product strategy.

About the role

As VP of Product, you will own AllSpice’s product strategy, roadmap, customer insights, product operating system, and product team.

You will serve as a key member of the leadership team and partner closely with the CEO, CTO, CRO, VP of Software, Sales, Customer Experience, Marketing, Design, and Engineering to define where the product is going, what customer and market opportunities we prioritize, and how product decisions help steer the business.

AllSpice is defining a new category for hardware engineering workflows, and the right leader will help decide what that category becomes.

You’ll inherit a product with strong technical foundations, passionate customers, a large roadmap surface, and clear enterprise pull. You’ll also help us sharpen product focus, improve roadmap prioritization, synthesize customer input, increase user adoption, build stronger product observability, and improve cross-functional decision-making.

You should be excited by highly technical products, specialized users, ambiguous markets, and the challenge of translating complex hardware development workflows into simple, durable, and valuable product experiences.

What you’ll do

Own product strategy and roadmap

  • Translate company goals, including revenue growth, customer expansion, product adoption, technical differentiation, and category leadership, into clear product priorities.

  • Build a roadmap that balances near-term customer needs, enterprise deal requirements, technical platform investments, and long-term category-defining bets.

  • Create a product planning cadence that gives Engineering clarity, gives GTM confidence, and gives leadership visibility into tradeoffs.

  • Help the company understand what we are building, why it matters, who it is for, and how it supports AllSpice’s business strategy.

Lead product discovery and customer insight

  • Build a rigorous customer discovery practice rooted in user research and mechanisms for turning customer feedback into product insights.

  • Spend meaningful time with hardware engineers, ECAD admins, engineering managers, executives, technical evaluators, buyers, and internal customer-facing teams.

  • Synthesize insights from customers, Sales, Customer Experience, Solutions, and Engineering, into clear product decisions.

  • Partner with GTM to clarify ICP, personas, positioning, launch narratives, and product adoption strategies.

Strengthen the product operating system

  • Improve how AllSpice moves from customer signal to product insight to initiative to epic to shipped product to adoption measurement.

  • Evolve product planning, prioritization, roadmap communication, launch, and feedback-loop processes so they scale with the company.

  • Create product metrics and dashboards that measure activation, adoption, engagement, retention, customer impact, and expansion signals.

  • Create clear frameworks for prioritizing customer requests, deal blockers, technical investments, usability improvements, and long-term strategic bets.

  • Ensure roadmap decisions are communicated clearly and consistently across the company.

Manage, mentor, and grow the product team

  • Lead, coach, and develop Product Managers and adjacent contributors, creating career development paths, feedback rhythms, and operating norms that help the team scale.

  • Help PMs improve at problem definition, stakeholder management, customer research, roadmap planning, product storytelling, and cross-functional leadership.

  • Hire and onboard future product leaders who raise the bar for customer empathy, technical fluency, strategic clarity, and execution.

  • Foster a product culture that is rigorous, collaborative, customer-obsessed, commercially aware, and comfortable operating in ambiguity.

Partner with leadership to steer the business

  • Serve as a strategic partner to the leadership team in setting company direction and making executive-level tradeoffs.

  • Bring product judgment into business decisions, including market focus, customer segmentation, expansion opportunities, and strategic bets.

  • Partner closely with the CTO and VP of Software to ensure product strategy, technical architecture, and software execution stay tightly aligned.

  • Represent the product perspective in executive planning, board conversations, GTM strategy, hiring plans, and company operating rhythms.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including product leadership experience in a B2B software or hardware technology company.

  • Experience building products for hardware development, electrical engineering, ECAD, MCAD, PLM, PDM, manufacturing, supply chain, robotics, aerospace, automotive, medical devices, industrial systems, or similarly complex technical engineering workflows.

  • Experience managing, mentoring, and developing Product Managers.

  • Demonstrated ability to own product strategy and roadmap for a complex technical product.

  • Strong customer discovery skills, with experience working directly with highly technical users and enterprise buyers.

  • Excellent prioritization judgment across customer requests, revenue urgency, technical constraints, and long-term product strategy.

  • Experience building product operating systems, including planning cadences, roadmap frameworks, product metrics, launch processes, discovery practices, and feedback loops.

  • Ability to communicate clearly at multiple altitudes, including executive strategy, customer workflow details, and engineering tradeoffs.

  • Strong product taste and high standards for usability, quality, and customer impact in complex technical products.

  • Commercial judgment and experience working closely with Sales, Customer Success, or GTM teams to prioritize customer input and support business goals.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and creating structure without slowing the company down.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building AI-assisted products where accuracy, trust, explainability, and workflow integration matter.

  • Experience with enterprise deployments, self-hosted products, SOC 2, SSO, security reviews, and complex technical evaluations.

  • Experience leading product through a platform evolution, major UX reboot, or migration from an inherited technical or product foundation.

  • Experience representing product strategy in board, investor, or executive planning conversations.

  • Familiarity with developer tools, collaboration platforms, version control, automation platforms, or CI/CD systems.

Why join now

AllSpice combines a large underserved market, urgent enterprise pain, strong technical differentiation, early customer validation, and a product vision that can reshape how hardware teams build.

For the next phase, we’re looking for someone who can build a focused, scalable product organization without losing the technical depth, customer empathy, and urgency that got us here.

This is a unique opportunity to define the product strategy, operating system, and product team for a company building a new category at the intersection of software, hardware, and AI.


Role Details

  • Location: Hybrid, San Francisco based with in-office collaboration 2 days/week.

  • Compensation: $265,000 - $315,000 base salary range + equity

  • Benefits: health, vision, dental, unlimited PTO, home office stipend, and travel stipend.

  • Team: Leads a team of 3 Product Managers today, with room to grow as scope expands.

  • AllSpice is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Parsing (Principal/Staff/Senior)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help define the future of hardware development by building a collaboration platform for circuit designs, enabling the next generation of smart vehicles, IoT devices, rockets, medical devices, robotics, and much more.

At AllSpice, we're building the agile development framework for hardware designers, including a Git-friendly translation layer and automated CI/CD framework for native circuit designs — think GitHub/GitLab + Copilot for electronics.

Read more about our latest Series A announcement here!

 

Role and Responsibilities

The parsing team provides the institutional knowledge, SDKs and data model that sits at the bottom of the stack and other teams consume to build out services, experiences, and automations.

For most projects, you will be responsible for working with engineers from each relevant team to determine

  • What data they need

    • What is the shape and structure of that data? What stability guarantees do we have for that data? Do we already provide that data in a different format?

  • How we can provide that data

    • Do we need to parse new files from our customers? Is it an external database?

  • The interface the team will use to consume that data

    • Are we providing them an SDK / Code module? Are we spinning up a service?

Along with this you will need to coordinate with the rest of the parsing team to determine when to extend existing interfaces or create new ones.

You will also be responsible for coordinating with product managers, sales and other stakeholders to provide timelines, expected features and constraints for the projects you are working on.

This is a highly autonomous role and the expectation is that you work collaborative, self-driven way.

Example Projects

  • Provide the capabilities to merge binary file formats maintaining the overall structure and usability of the resulting file.

  • Provide the SDK for generating Schematics, PCBs, and other ECAD data, used by both the AI and Automations teams.

  • Improve performance of the parsing engine.

  • Develop and implement parsers for new formats as required.

Our Stack

  • Rust (CLI, services, SDK, etc.)

  • GitHub

Other teams use

  • Go (Fork of Gitea)

  • TypeScript

  • Rust (services, AI, automations)

  • Python (scripting, AI)

  • PostgreSQL

Skills and Requirements

  • Experience working on systems-level software

  • Experience writing parsers

  • Experience writing test harnesses and dev tooling around the core software

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to drive cross-functional initiatives

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a high degree of autonomy

  • Can think in terms of the big picture and deliver on the details

  • Fluency with AI tools — you use them day-to-day to debug, document, and reduce operational toil, and expect this to be a normal part of how the team operates

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen or Lawful Permanent Resident (Green Card holder)

Bonuses

  • Experience designing hardware or working with ECAD tooling (Altium, KiCad, Cadence, Siemens)

  • Rust Experience

  • Compiler Experience

  • Experience with Hex Editors and binary debugging tools

  • Low-level knowledge of Git

  • Availability to work out of our flex offices in San Francisco or Boston 1–2 days per week

  • Experience with the Crysknife parser would be a big bonus

Benefits

  • Opportunity to make a large impact

  • Supportive and smart colleagues

  • Flexible work

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Health, dental, and vision benefits

  • Generous PTO

  • Home office stipend

  • Relocation package
